notes: Sign-in is now encrypted. The accounts service — the part that checks who you are at sign-in — previously ran over plain HTTP, meaning credentials crossed the internet unencrypted; the server now runs behind TLS and this release points FleetComm at the encrypted address. You MUST update to this version to sign in: older versions point at the old unencrypted address, which is closed. Voice was and remains a separate, encrypted connection and is unaffected. Everyone will need to sign in with Discord again once after updating. This release also proves out v0.12.4's visible updater: if you're on v0.12.4, this update should install itself inside the full-screen notice and greet you with an acknowledgement screen when it's done.
